security_problem: SECURITY INVARIANT: The Proof Console never invents an allow/deny. Panels render only records already written by the real proxy (audit JSONL) and the mock server (observe-log). A missing deny or a received http_post is shown as incomplete/failed proof, not as a scripted success. SUPPORTED MODEL: Local one-shot scripted proof (file_read 100 → file_read 200 → http_post 300) against the built-in mock server, served on loopback or Tailscale CGNAT (100.64.0.0/10) only. ATTACK CLASSES: simulated-decision; non-loopback-bind; missing-non-relay-claim; dashboard-feed-as-evidence. FAILURE SEMANTICS: Wildcard, LAN, and public binds fail closed. Empty or malformed ledger yields no decision. Observe-log showing http_post #300 fails the proof. Uncertainty never renders a successful deny. NON-GOALS: policy editor, accounts, fleet views, replacing --dashboard, changing allow/deny, exposing the UI from the mcp-visor binary or on 0.0.0.0.
required_behavior: examples/demo-runner -ui serves a local Proof Console on loopback (default 127.0.0.1:9092) or an explicit Tailscale CGNAT address in 100.64.0.0/10. GET /api/snapshot returns parsed audit JSONL events and observe-log lines from the files the runner already creates; it does not call DashboardProvider or invent policy_decision values. After the real three-call sequence, the snapshot contains tool_call_allowed, session_tainted, and tool_call_denied (policy_rule=block_sensitive_egress), allow events carry hash/prev_hash/chain_index, and http_post #300 is absent from observations. The HTML maps event_type/fields only; empty ledger shows no deny.
failure_behavior: Empty host, 0.0.0.0, ::, RFC1918 LAN, and public IPs are rejected before Listen. Loopback and Tailscale CGNAT (100.64.0.0/10) are allowed. Missing or empty audit/observe files yield empty arrays and no deny. If the mock observe-log records http_post #300, integrity reports failure and the console must not claim non-relay success.
non_goals: user accounts or authentication beyond loopback or Tailscale bind
exposing the Proof Console from the mcp-visor binary

attack_classes.expected: empty or deny-less audit JSONL never produces policy_decision=deny in the snapshot; the UI does not hardcode a successful deny
listen addresses that are not loopback or Tailscale CGNAT (100.64.0.0/10) fail closed before the HTTP server starts; 0.0.0.0, empty host, RFC1918, and public IPs are rejected
non-relay is claimed only from observe-log absence of http_post #300; empty observations do not prove the denied call never reached the server
snapshot is built from audit JSONL and observe-log only, never from Proxy.DashboardProvider or /api/calls session history
